name: Bitcart
description: Self-hosted cryptocurrency payment processor for accepting Bitcoin and other coins.
composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      DB_URL: "postgres://bitcart:{{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}@{{serviceName}}-postgres:5432/bitcart"
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
      BITCART_ADMIN_KEY: {{env.BITCART_ADMIN_KEY}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/data:/data
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-postgres
      - {{serviceName}}-redis
  {{serviceName}}-postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-postgres
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: bitcart
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
      POSTGRES_DB: bitcart
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data
  {{serviceName}}-redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-redis
    restart: unless-stopped
